title: Airtable returns 429 and then keeps failing for 30 seconds after a burst of requests to one base
symptoms: Rate limit exceeded. Please try again later
Parallel sync workers stall for half a minute at a time
cause: The API allows 5 requests per second per base and 50 per second across all traffic from one user's tokens. Going over earns a 30 second penalty, so fast retries extend the outage.
fix: Queue requests per base at 5 per second or fewer, batch writes 10 records at a time, and wait at least 30 seconds after a 429 before retrying.
affected: Airtable Web API, limits as published 2026-10 (5 per second per base, 50 per second per user token)
